en: What's going on here!?
Oh, Kaede. Perfect timing.

I...really don't know what to do, Kaede.
Ryoma started talking crazy...
All I was doing was making a suggestion.

So that more people can survive.
...Even if it's just one more.

"So that more people can survive"...?
Ryoma, what do you mean by that?

Don't you get it? If time runs out like this, 
we'll all get annihilated, y'know?

The only way to avoid that is to play 
along with this killing game.
What!? Now, hold on a minute!
Kill me.
Ryoma! What are you saying!?

You don't get that either? I'm saying that 
I'll give you guys my life.
I...don't have a reason to live anymore.

So if the rest of you want to live, 
I'll hand my life over to you.

N-No way! We promised we'd all get out
of here together!

Hmph, I hoped it'd end that way. That's why
I waited so long to bring this up.

But we've just been waiting for the deadline
without doing anything to change it.

There's no more time left for idealism, 
don't you think?
N-No...it's not idealism—
This is the best choice for this situation.

Whoever murders me gets to leave without a 
trial. Everyone else survives the time limit...

After that, the person who gets to escape 
can go for help and rescue everyone else.

How about it? If you've got a better idea, 
I'd love to hear it.
U-Um...well...

<CLT=cltMIND>What should I do? Maybe if I share Shuichi's
plan with him, Ryoma will change his mind—
Ryoma. There's no need for that.
Hm?

There's no need for that, because I'm going
to end this game.
I've already decided.
You're...going to end this game?

It's not about outfoxing everyone in this
killing game, it's about ending the game itself.
That's the real goal.
Can you...even accomplish such a feat?

I wouldn't be saying this if
I didn't think I could.

And how will you end it? You understand
that the time limit expires tonight, yes?

Haha, sorry, can't tell you. Actually, if
I could, I wouldn't be having so much trouble.
What do you mean?

Just what I said.
I'm going to end this game...

So don't any of you go and do
anything unnecessary, alright?
Unnecessary...?

Hmph, when you put it like that, it seems 
like I still have a ways to go.
Alright, I got it. I take back my suggestion.

Do what you want. Whether you guys 
live or die is up to you.

<CLT=cltMIND>After Ryoma said that, he left
the dining hall.

Geez, that Ryoma...
I hope I helped calm him down a little.

Anyway, Rantaro... Were you serious when
you said you knew a way to end this game?
...Not sure.
What?

Well, even if I *did* have an idea, I couldn't
tell you. Can't risk anyone interfering.

Okie-dokie... Then Angie will pray for your
strategy's success, Rantaro.

But if you're lying, Atua says He will punish
you for three generations to come, okay?

Haha, now that's a threat. Well, I'll do my
best to live up to your expectations, hm?
I guess...I *have* to do my best.

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro left, but what he said had
really affected me.

Ending this game...
Is that even possible?

I suspect he only said that to defuse 
the situation and stop Ryoma.
I mean, ending this game...?
Nyhahahaha, you don't know that!

Maybe Rantaro's <CLT=cltSTRONG>hidden talent<CLT=cltNORMAL> is actually a
huge explosion! In the end, only Atua knows!
<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro's hidden talent...

<CLT=cltMIND>I want to know what it is, but we don't have
much time left. I can't worry about that now.
<CLT=cltMIND>I need to do something...

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't have time to worry about things I don't
understand... I just need to do what I can.
<CLT=cltMIND>Or else...I won't be able to protect everyone.

<CLT=cltMIND>I should go meet up with Shuichi. It's the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>classroom by the stairs to the basement<CLT=cltMIND>, right?

Ryoma started talking crazy,
we didn't know what to do...
Kaede, listen to him...

His suggestion...
Perhaps you should hear it as well.
I shall observe...

Your beauty...as you all accept that 
the end is upon you.

I think it would be best if you heard Ryoma's
idea for yourself...

From there, everyone else can decide what
should be done.

My desire is to fulfill the desires of others, so
I shall comply with everyone's final decision.
Ohhh? We're unluckier than I thought.

The last time I saw them, they looked like
they were arguing.

Atua has spoken...
All humans will die eventually.

Nyahahaha! But I'm not scared cuz I've got
Atua with me!
<CLT=cltMIND>I need to talk to Ryoma!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wish I had a big TV like this at my house.
I'll ask Dad to get me one after I escape.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Dining Hall Rules"

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"You may eat any food you
find in the dining hall."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Please take responsibility for all utensils and
dishes used and clean up after yourself."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"The dining hall will be locked
during nighttime."
<CLT=cltMIND>I need to talk to Ryoma!

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm meeting up with Shuichi at the <CLT=cltSTRONG>classroom
by the stairs to the basement<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>If I exit here, I'll have to walk quite a
bit to get there.
